verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm FIDO2 supports optional PIN-based user verification in addition to touch/presence (yubikey-docs-6), and community evidence corroborates PIN enrollment is a real, if sometimes overlooked, setup step (yubikey-comm-13). This directly matches on-device verification (PIN) preventing a stolen key alone from authenticating; biometric variants exist on Bio series keys but aren't explicitly documented here. Missing for 10: explicit mention of built-in biometric/fingerprint verification and independent hands-on confirmation of PIN enforcement blocking a stolen key.
